name: Hidden Genius Project Immersion Program
what_you_do: You can join a free 15 month program (800+ hours) for Black male high school students. The page describes mentorship, coding and entrepreneurship training.
who_can_apply: Black male students entering grades 9, 10 or 11. No coding experience needed. Must commit to the full 15 months.
pay_detail: Free to join; no stipend listed
deadline_text: Our 2027 application is now open (apply page, checked 2026-10-10). No closing date is posted. The immersion page's last listed deadline was Feb 21, 2025.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Immersion Program page on hiddengeniusproject.org.
notes: The apply page says OUR 2027 APPLICATION IS NOW OPEN and lists no closing date. The immersion page still shows the old Feb 21, 2025 deadline. The immersion page lists Oakland and Richmond among its sites.
